verdict.rationale: Clerk's docs say Organizations exist to build multi-tenant B2B apps (Slack/Linear/Vercel-style). Users can belong to multiple organizations, and each session carries memberships, Roles and the Active Organization. Drop-in UI lets users create and switch organizations and view memberships and invitations, with default admin/member Roles plus custom Roles and Permissions. The community complaint that roles are tied to organizations critiques the RBAC design rather than contradicting the org model. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the invitation flow (sending, accepting, revoking invites), and independent hands-on corroboration of the org and invitation features.
